profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, Embedded Linux & Industrial Automation | Hardware Integration, Energy Storage & Power-Testing Systems
profile.summary:
I build software that connects complex hardware with reliable, efficient automation.
As a Software Engineer specializing in industrial automation and energy technology, I develop software for embedded systems, hardware integration, equipment calibration, and automated power testing. 

My experience includes supporting next-generation energy-storage technology at Form Energy and leading software engineering initiatives at Alencon Systems, a manufacturer of DC-DC optimizers for solar and energy-storage applications.

I work primarily with Python, embedded Linux and Yocto, Modbus communication protocols, APIs, and web technologies. 

Throughout my career, I have developed production tools that streamline testing and calibration, reduce manual effort, improve system reliability, and minimize the need for on-site technical support. I’m comfortable owning products from initial requirements and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

I enjoy solving problems where software, hardware, and real-world operations intersect. I work effectively across software, electrical, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to turn complex technical requirements into maintainable solutions that deliver practical results.

Areas of expertise: Python development - Embedded Linux and Yocto - Industrial automation - Modbus - Hardware/software integration - Calibration and power-testing software - Energy storage and solar technology - API integration - Web applications - Technical troubleshooting

I’m always interested in connecting with engineering professionals and organizations developing innovative software, automation, renewable-energy, and energy-storage technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Contractor/Consultant
positions.description:
Develop and enhance calibration and automated power-testing software for next-generation energy-storage hardware.

Collaborate with software, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers on new hardware/software integration initiatives.

Build tooling that improves test repeatability, data collection, system reliability, and production readiness.

Support the development and manufacturing of grid-scale, multi-day energy-storage systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software engineering and IT initiatives for a manufacturer of DC-DC optimizers used in solar and energy-storage systems.

Develop and maintain embedded Linux applications supporting product configuration, communication, calibration, and testing.

Build Python-based calibration and automated power-testing tools that reduce manual effort and improve production efficiency.

Design customer-facing solutions that minimize dependence on on-site technical support.

Implement Modbus communication, register-address configuration, APIs, and new product functionality.

Own software initiatives from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Developed, tested, debugged, and documented software using Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Contributed to software-development and security improvements for Schneider Electric products.

Collaborated with QA and engineering teams to validate releases against functional and security requirements.

Improved existing software for maintainability, performance, scalability, and reliability.

Produced software design and architecture documentation to support future development.

positions.title: Information Technology Administrator
positions.locationName: Atlantic City, New Jersey, United States
